hints: The red spinner has 4 sides: $1, 2, 3, 3$. The blue spinner has 3 sides: $-1, 0, 2$. There are $4 \times 3 = 12$ equally likely outcomes.
Calculate the difference $X = \text{Red} - \text{Blue}$ for each of the 12 outcomes.
Count the frequency of each value out of 12 and present in a probability distribution table.
walkthrough:
List all 12 equally likely pairs $(\text{Red}, \text{Blue})$ and calculate $X = \text{Red} - \text{Blue}$:
$$\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|}
\hline
\text{Red} \setminus \text{Blue} & -1 & 0 & 2 \\
\hline
1 & 1 - (-1) = 2 & 1 - 0 = 1 & 1 - 2 = -1 \\
2 & 2 - (-1) = 3 & 2 - 0 = 2 & 2 - 2 = 0 \\
3 & 3 - (-1) = 4 & 3 - 0 = 3 & 3 - 2 = 1 \\
3 & 3 - (-1) = 4 & 3 - 0 = 3 & 3 - 2 = 1 \\
\hline
\end{array}$$

Construct the probability distribution table:
$$\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|c|c|} \hline x & -1 & 0 & 1 & 2 & 3 & 4 \\ \hline \mathrm{P}(X = x) & \frac{1}{12} & \frac{1}{12} & \frac{3}{12} & \frac{2}{12} & \frac{3}{12} & \frac{2}{12} \\ \hline \end{array}$$
teacher_walkthrough: Two fair spinners are spun simultaneously: Red with sides $(1, 2, 3, 3)$ and Blue with sides $(-1, 0, 2)$. The score $X$ is Red minus Blue.

Step 1: Determine total number of outcomes.
Red has 4 sides and Blue has 3 sides, so there are $4 \times 3 = 12$ equally likely outcomes.

Step 3: Collect frequencies for each distinct value of $X$:
- $x = -1$: 1 occurrence $\implies \mathrm{P}(X = -1) = \frac{1}{12}$
- $x = 0$: 1 occurrence $\implies \mathrm{P}(X = 0) = \frac{1}{12}$
- $x = 1$: 3 occurrences $\implies \mathrm{P}(X = 1) = \frac{3}{12}$
- $x = 2$: 2 occurrences $\implies \mathrm{P}(X = 2) = \frac{2}{12}$
- $x = 3$: 3 occurrences $\implies \mathrm{P}(X = 3) = \frac{3}{12}$
- $x = 4$: 2 occurrences $\implies \mathrm{P}(X = 4) = \frac{2}{12}$

Step 4: Present in the distribution table:
$$\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|c|c|} \hline x & -1 & 0 & 1 & 2 & 3 & 4 \\ \hline \mathrm{P}(X = x) & \frac{1}{12} & \frac{1}{12} & \frac{3}{12} & \frac{2}{12} & \frac{3}{12} & \frac{2}{12} \\ \hline \end{array}$$

hints: Calculate the mean $\mathrm{E}(X) = \sum x \,\mathrm{P}(X = x)$ using the probabilities from part (i).
Use the variance formula $\operatorname{Var}(X) = \mathrm{E}(X^2) - [\mathrm{E}(X)]^2$ to find the variance.
walkthrough:
Calculate the expected value $\mathrm{E}(X)$:
$$\mathrm{E}(X) = \sum x \,\mathrm{P}(X = x)$$
$$\mathrm{E}(X) = \frac{(-1)(1) + 0(1) + 1(3) + 2(2) + 3(3) + 4(2)}{12} = \frac{-1 + 0 + 3 + 4 + 9 + 8}{12} = \frac{23}{12}$$
teacher_walkthrough: We calculate the variance $\operatorname{Var}(X)$ of the score from the distribution table found in part (i).

Step 3: Compute $\operatorname{Var}(X) = \mathrm{E}(X^2) - [\mathrm{E}(X)]^2$:
$$\operatorname{Var}(X) = \frac{71}{12} - \left(\frac{23}{12}\right)^2 = \frac{71 \times 12}{144} - \frac{529}{144}$$
$$\operatorname{Var}(X) = \frac{852 - 529}{144} = \frac{323}{144} \approx 2.2431$$
Rounding to 3 significant figures gives $\operatorname{Var}(X) = 2.24$ (or exact fraction $\frac{323}{144}$).

Alternative Component Verification:
Using independence of the two spinners: $\operatorname{Var}(X) = \operatorname{Var}(\text{Red}) + \operatorname{Var}(\text{Blue})$.
$\mathrm{E}(\text{Red}) = 2.25$, $\mathrm{E}(\text{Red}^2) = 5.75 \implies \operatorname{Var}(\text{Red}) = 5.75 - 5.0625 = 0.6875 = 11/16$.
$\mathrm{E}(\text{Blue}) = 1/3$, $\mathrm{E}(\text{Blue}^2) = 5/3 \implies \operatorname{Var}(\text{Blue}) = 5/3 - 1/9 = 14/9$.
$\operatorname{Var}(X) = 11/16 + 14/9 = (99 + 224)/144 = 323/144$.
